samples.claim: Plain Range path constructs RowAddrTreeMap, applies mask, walks inclusive low32 runs, recombines high32 fragment and offsets, subtracts range.start/adds prior sequence offset, and coalesces adjacent runs within this segment. End reconstruction uses bitwise OR of frag<<32 and low_end+1. At low_end=u32MAX with odd fragment, carry bit overlaps existing high bits: for singleton ID8589934591 in range8589934591..8589934592, computed end is4294967296 and subtraction underflows instead of producing ordinal1. This is source-derived, unexecuted; iter_runs exposes inclusive u32 runs and insert_range can store that singleton (rust/lance-select/src/mask.rs:545-588; rust/lance-select/src/mask.rs:801-810).
samples.review_note: Inclusive run end is incremented before bitwise OR. Fresh insert_range and iter_runs establish the u32MAX singleton case; the arithmetic underflow is a source deduction, not an executed reproduction.

samples.claim: Default DataFileFieldInterner holds separate caches for field IDs and column indices plus one shared cache for inline created/updated version bytes. Private InternCache<T:Eq+Hash+Clone> is Small(Vec<Arc<[T]>>) or Large(HashMap<Arc<[T]>,()>), threshold16. Documentation claims multi-GB savings at20M fragments and a favorable linear-scan crossover for20-200-byte payloads; these are source assertions, not measured results.
samples.evidence:
312 | /// Interns repeated data so that fragments with identical content share a
313 | /// single heap allocation via `Arc`.
314 | ///
315 | /// At 20M fragments the deduplication typically saves multiple GB of heap
316 | /// because every fragment in a homogeneous table carries the same field list,
317 | /// and post-compaction fragments share identical version metadata bytes.
318 | ///
319 | /// Uses a `Vec`-based linear scan when the cache is small (<=16 entries)
320 | /// and upgrades to `HashMap` for larger caches. In the common homogeneous
321 | /// case (1-3 unique values), linear scan avoids per-fragment hashing overhead.
322 | #[derive(Default)]
323 | pub struct DataFileFieldInterner {
324 |     fields: InternCache<i32>,
325 |     column_indices: InternCache<i32>,
326 |     inline_bytes: InternCache<u8>,
327 | }
328 | 
329 | /// A cache that uses linear scan for small sizes and HashMap for large.
330 | /// The threshold is chosen so that scan + compare is cheaper than hash for
331 | /// typical payload sizes (20-200 bytes).
332 | enum InternCache<T: Eq + std::hash::Hash + Clone> {
333 |     Small(Vec<Arc<[T]>>),
334 |     Large(HashMap<Arc<[T]>, ()>),
335 | }
336 | 
337 | const INTERN_CACHE_UPGRADE_THRESHOLD: usize = 16;
338 |
samples.review_note: Three caches, shared version bytes, generic constraints and threshold16 match. Performance claims remain attributed comments, not measurements.
